requirement: Build from my business picks the template by the trade across every CMS while a plain demo build never picks for the person, and the demo check fails on any collected fact, review or own photo missing, or on a visible fault

oracle.invariant: S1: always ja-restaurant/ja-fresco/ja-diner with reason auto:restaurant-match; emdash does not decide; wordpress does (cms:wordpress); a bar adds kind:bars; at least three distinct picks over forty seeds; no cards → unavailable. S2: the bar gets the bar-restaurant Joomla card with reason auto:restaurant-match;kind:bars; replay makes no new action and no new charge; no cards → 503 NO_TEMPLATE_OFFERED; a plain {auto:true} or empty selection → 400 DEMO_TEMPLATE_REQUIRED and no action; a CMS alone takes its /ops/wo pin. S3: coverage.reviews; valid; valid; unplaced; coverage.photos. S4: pass; findings name, phone, email, address, hours, reviews, home-photo, photos in that order; pass with waived.reviews. S5: one call with eight labelled pictures, 1024×2400 JPEG desktop slices; only closed-list faults kept; looked:false with NO_VISION_MODEL, VISION_FAILED, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, pass true.
